name: prompt-372
image_vibe: 1990s direct-flash bedroom, cozy personal-room nostalgia, raw analog snapshot
image_purpose: Create a playful 1990s-style personal portrait while preserving the approved face reference.

prompt.project_info: A 1990s-style direct-flash portrait of an original adult woman in a cozy personal room.
prompt.main_subject: The approved adult face reference must be preserved. The subject has porcelain-white skin, messy dark-brown hair tied up, a calm playful smile, and wears a modern oversized cream sweater.
prompt.composition_elements: Direct front-flash portrait against a dark white wall covered with aesthetic magazine posters and stickers, evoking a cozy bedroom or personal room.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dim room ambience with direct front flash, defined snapshot shadows, playful calm mood, and nostalgic 1990s personal-room atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 1990s compact-camera look, direct front flash, realistic skin texture, analog grain, slightly imperfect framing, natural hair detail, no digital overprocessing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Without changing the approved adult face reference, create a portrait of an original adult woman with porcelain-white skin and messy dark-brown hair tied up, captured with a 1990s-style camera using direct front flash. She poses with a calm yet playful smile and wears a modern oversized cream sweater. Set her against a dark white wall covered with aesthetic magazine posters and stickers, evoking a cozy bedroom or personal room atmosphere under dim lighting.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, nudity, transparent clothing, sexualized pose, altered approved face, inconsistent likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: approved adult face reference
assets.usage: Preserve the approved adult face, facial structure, and likeness; do not replace with a celebrity or public-figure identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: The face reference is required and must remain consistent. Preserve the cream sweater, direct-flash 1990s portrait, wall posters, and room atmosphere; background posters and non-face styling may be replaced.
